terms.gloss: throw out, drive out, turn out
evidence: Plaut. Asin. 632: hinc mēd amantem ex aedibus ējēcit hujus māter

terms.gloss: push out, bundle out of doors
evidence: Plaut. Aul. 44: Nam quā mē nunc causā extrūsistī ex aedibus?
Cic. de Or. 2.234: tē in viam … extrūdam et ējiciam (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: Nam quā mē nunc causā extrūsistī ex aedibus?
phrases.english: Now why have you pushed me out of the house?

phrases.latin: Sīcine hoc fit? forās aedibus mē ējicī?
phrases.english: Is this how it goes? Me, thrown out of the house?

sources: Lewis & Short: eicio · Lewis & Short: extrudo
